title: Why Does Music Move Us?
question: How does a patterned sequence of sounds with no inherent meaning reliably produce real emotion, and why did that capacity evolve?
summary: Music has no survival-relevant content -- no calories, no mates, no danger -- yet it reliably moves people to tears, chills, and joy across every known culture. Explaining why is a genuine unsolved problem at the intersection of neuroscience, evolution, and aesthetics.
